objective: Melhorar a seta continua de +15 min: erro geral, estabilidade e magnitude dos extremos
authorization: Pedido da equipe para executar todas as ideias de aprimoramento, com custo controlado por etapas

stages.name: confirmation
stages.variants: baseline15 and best promising candidate from screening; no test used

stages.name: final
stages.rule: train chosen configuration using train/validation only; freeze before test diagnostic

screening_selection: Prefer candidates satisfying all safeguards; among those, lowest macro MAE. If none, confirm lowest macro-MAE promising candidate as investigation; never label approved until all confirmation criteria pass
combination_note: Combined channels with and without weighted loss are explicitly tested for interactions, including when an isolated modification fails
test_policy: Exploratory; never used to choose candidate or change acceptance criteria
preparation: manifest.json and all three blocks remain frozen; configs/aprimoramento_v2.json records the initial grid draft
